title: Test Your Logic: 7 Riddles, 15 Seconds Each. Can You Get 7/7? 🧠
seo_intro:
Test your logic with 7 riddles: can you get 7/7? Brain teasers and logic puzzles with answers, with 15 seconds to think about each one.
The bat and the ball, the lily pads, the burning ropes, the T-shirt holes, the rope around the Earth, the birthday paradox and the Monty Hall problem. Vote in the comments, keep score, and tell us your result out of 7!
